summary: Cullinan Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026 disclosing, under Items 7.01 and 8.01, initiation of a rolling NDA submission to the FDA for zipalertinib plus platinum-based chemotherapy in previously untreated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC with EGFR exon 20 insertion mutations, reviewed under the Real-Time Oncology Review program. The filing cites positive Phase 3 REZILIENT3 data and notes a separate monotherapy accelerated-approval NDA under review with a PDUFA date of February 27, 2027. Completion of the combination NDA submission is expected by year-end 2026. No deal terms, advisors, board recommendation, or special-situation mechanics are stated; the event is a routine regulatory milestone disclosure, not a special situation.
